articles.title: Google and Apple seek crypto talent as Big Tech eyes stablecoin and tokenization rails
articles.snippet: The tech giants’ job listings could indicate that they are separately pursuing experts in stablecoins and tokenized deposits for future projects.

articles.title: ECB deploys Pontes platform to settle wholesale tokenized assets in central-bank money
articles.snippet: The EU central bank's new wholesale platform connects DLT market infrastructure to its payment rails, separate from the retail digital euro pilot planned for 2027.
